Name: Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard (Now with seasonals and customizable hair)
Author: Jellonip
Description:
[center]
[b][size=5][color=#00ffff][u]
[/u][/color][/size][/b]

﻿﻿[/center][img]https://i.gyazo.com/0a1ddf6a17192f48a3f63ec29e6292b2.png[/img][center]﻿[/center][center][size=5][b][color=#b4a7d6]Now features alternative hairstyles AND 2 sets of seasonal outfits![/color][/b][/size][/center]

Exactly what it says on the tin. Acts as an alternative to my Gigi style portraits that fits *slightly* more into Vanilla's aesthetic, but is still designed for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR. [/url]

Contains a total of 19 total expressions, 1 pink for SVE, and 12 beach portraits, fabulous eyelashes and all in glorious 64px default game resolution.

To install, simply drop the folder into your mods folder. Automatically overwrites Poltergeister's seasonal cute portraits. 

If you are upgrading from an older edition, please delete the older version entirely and then install this one.
[b]
[u][size=5]The [color=#00ff00]12 expression version[/color] is in the optional files due to request for other mods that use it.[/size][/u][/b]


[img]https://i.gyazo.com/400b283bc82ee5702045932c99edfef1.png[/img]


[b][center][color=#ff0000][size=6][u]PLEASE MAKE SURE YOU [/u][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=6][u]ONLY[/u][/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=6][u] HAVE [/u][/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]ONE[/u][/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=6][u] OF THE BELOW INSTALLED. IF YOU HAVE [/u][/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]MULTIPLE[/u][/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=6][u], IT WILL [/u][/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=6][u]CAUSE THE GAME TO ACT STRANGE IN CERTAIN INSTANCES[/u][/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=6][u]. [/u][/size][/color][size=5][color=#00ffff][u][/u][/color][/size][/center][size=5][color=#00ffff][u]
[/u][/color][/size][/b]


[b][size=5]Event Edition([color=#00ffff]RECOMMENDED FOR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url][/color]): [/size][/b]
Enable customizing Magnus' look via RRRR exclusive ingame story events accessible after at least 2 seasons of marriage. I suggest you get this version if you are planning to play RRRR or are currently playing RRRR for the story content. It's far more in character for him to be this extra after he's been propped up by the farmer. Take a look inside the spoiler for specific mechanic details. (Over 14k words worth of content!)

[b][u][center][color=#00ffff][size=5]Important: Events take place inside Magnus' spouse room, therefore are not compatible with spouse room replacers! [/size][/color][size=5]Please also make sure RRRR is up to date![/size][/center][/u][/b]
[b][center][color=#ff0000][size=5]DO NOT GET THIS VERSION IF YOU ARE NOT PLAYING [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url]﻿! IT WILL LITERALLY DO NOTHING BUT PROVIDE THE BASE ASSETS.[/size][/color][/center][/b][b]
[size=4][center]Hair and Seasonal Unlocks + Event information:[/center][/size][/b][spoiler]
[b][size=4]Hair Mechanics:[/size]
Unlock Requirements: [/b]
[list]
[*]Have been married for at least 2 seasons.
[*]Magnus is at 10 hearts or above
[/list]
Once the event plays, Magnus will give you a crafting recipe for a hair styling kit as well as an actual hair styling kit before allowing you to style his hair. Gift him the kit while he is at home to style his hair via a repeatable event at any point. Quests will be added to your quest log to track what hair style he currently has and to remind the player how to trigger the styling. All hairstyles are unique to their specific hair length.

[b]Hair Length/Growth Mechanics:
[/b]Trigger by asking Magnus to grow his hair out to the next length during the hair styling event. The three lengths are Short -> Medium Length -> Long.
It takes roughly a season (28 days in game) for the hair to grow out from one length to another. While Magnus is growing his hair out, you will only be able to style the bangs. There are a total of 4 stages of growth for transitioning between hair lengths (base original length, stage 1, stage 2, fully grown and ready to style) with visual changes for each stage of hair growth. Each visual stage lasts roughly 9 days. [b]Do not attempt to rush this process. [u][color=#ff0000]Time travelling will not work.[/color][/u][/b][u]
[/u]
Example: Short to Mid Length

Return to a previous stage of hair length by simply selecting to cut it during the hair styling scene.

[center]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center][b][size=4]Clothing Mechanics[/size][/b]
[b]Seasonal 1 Unlock Requirements: [/b]
[list]
[*]Have unlocked the Hair events
[/list][list=1]
[*]Between 10AM and 3PM
[*]It's NOT winter
[*]It's Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday
[*]Magnus is at 10 hearts or above.
[*]It's been at least 4 days since unlocking the hair events. (You must play through 4 days, time travelling doesn't work)

[/list]
Once the first event is done, visit the tower again the next day to trigger part 2. Finally wait a season (28 days) and part 3 should automatically play upon waking up. Magnus will present you with a small note and a crafting recipe for said note to give to him for him to switch between his seasonal outfits and his usual robes. [b]Do not attempt to rush this. [u][color=#ff0000]Time travelling will not work.[/color][/u][/b]
[u]
Magnus will only take off the cloak while at the farm house because that is where he feels most comfortable.
[/u](I may add an option to have him always wear the cloak like in my config version if there is enough demand for it (unlikely).)


[b]Seasonal 2 Unlock Requirements: [/b]
[list]
[*]Have unlocked the Hair events AND the original seasonals.
[*]Have been married for at least a year
[*]20% change of triggering when visiting the tower:
[/list][list=1]
[*]Between 10AM and 3PM
[*]It's NOT winter
[*]It's sunny
[*]It's Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday
[*]Magnus is at 10 hearts or above.
[/list]Once the first event is done, visit the tower again the next day to trigger part 2. Finally wait a season and a week (33 days) and part 3 should automatically play upon waking up. Using the clothing ticket will have him asking how you would like him to wear the outfits (Original robes only, Seasonals 1, Seasonals 2, All seasonals). [b]Do not attempt to rush this. [u][color=#ff0000]Time travelling will not work.[/color][/u][/b]

[b]Loungewear Unlock Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Have Unlocked Seasonals 2
[*]Have 8 hearts with Sophia
[*]At least 15 days have passed since receiving the package for the 2nd set of Seasonals.
[/list]You will receive a mail from Sophia inviting you to hang out. Visit her house at any time in the day to see the event. Afterwards, gift the item from the event to Magnus while at home to see the second event. [b]THERE IS[color=#ff0000] NO WAY[/color] TO RECOVER THE ITEM IF YOU [color=#ff0000]LOSE IT[/color] OUTSIDE OF CHEATS! YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED. [/b]

Magnus will wear his loungewear while at home after 9pm at night.

[/spoiler]


[size=5] [b]Config Editions:[/b][/size]
Fully customize the Wizard's look via configuration options. [b]Different hairstyles currently not supported for the wedding [/b](he will have his original hairstyle). Please get this if you just want Magnus to look pretty, damned be it in character or not.

[size=5][b]Legacy Editions: [/b][/size]
The original version of this mod. [b]Only includes the base portraits and nothing else. [/b] Please download this version if you are using my portraits as a vehicle to implement your own via borrowing my code or just prefer it as simple as possible.
